description: This file contains functions for converting data values to various output formats such as JSON, string, list lines, and scope, primarily used for serialization and debugging within the GN build system.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a Value to its string representation without quotes.

methods.name: ToStringQuoted
methods.description: Converts a Value to its string representation with quotes.

methods.name: Indent
methods.description: Outputs indentation spaces based on the indent level.

methods.name: RenderScopeToJSON
methods.description: Recursively renders a scope Value as JSON.

methods.name: RenderListToJSON
methods.description: Recursively renders a list Value as JSON.

methods.name: OutputListLines
methods.description: Outputs each element of a list Value as a line.

methods.name: OutputString
methods.description: Outputs a Value as a string, quoted if necessary.

methods.name: OutputValue
methods.description: Outputs a Value, quoting if it's a string.

methods.name: OutputScope
methods.description: Outputs a scope Value as key-value pairs.

methods.name: OutputDefault
methods.description: Outputs a Value in default format based on its type.

methods.name: DoConvertValueToOutput
methods.description: Converts a Value to a specified output format, handling errors.

methods.name: ConvertValueToOutput
methods.description: Main function to convert a Value to an output format based on user-specified options.
